# Results summary (auto-generated by scripts/run_all.py)

## Calibration against the Boeing 737-800

- Published range: 5,436 km (2935 nmi, 162 pax).
- Model with literature cruise TSFC 0.627 lb/lbf/h predicts 6,068 km (+11.6 %).
- Effective c_T that reproduces the published range: 0.700 lb/lbf/h (absorbs climb/descent, taxi and other effects not modelled). Used for all studies.
- Wing mass (Raymer): 5,688 kg; W_fixed = 35,725 kg; k_f = 46.02 kg/m³.

## Multi-start

- 40 Latin-hypercube starts. ALM converged in 40; SLSQP succeeded in 40.
- Distinct final ranges (ALM, 0.1 km rounding): 5,705.4 km. This is numerical evidence, not proof, of global optimality.
